title: libcuflynx obs_data file (<name>_obs_data.json)
description: The top level of an obs_data file: an object with data_items, protocol_info and prediction_items, and an optional obs_data_name; or (legacy) a bare list of data items. Only the top level is described here: the items and protocol_info are validated by PrimitiveParsers.ObsAndParamIdParser.parse_obs_data_json, whose vocabularies are in libcuflynx/utilities/obs_data_helpers.py. Other top-level keys are allowed.

obs_data_name.description: the name of this obs_data set. In a module library, instances/<name>/<name>_obs_data.json must set it to <name> (a different or missing name is warned about).

data_items.description: the observations a model is scored against

prediction_items.description: outputs to predict (not scored in calibration). An item with a value (plus data_type, std, and obs_dt for a series) is held-out data: after calibration the prediction is validated against it (libcuflynx.param_id.validation, validation_results.json). An item with an operation (and optional operation_kwargs, as for a data item) is a scalar feature: its held-out value is compared with operation(operands), and sensitivity analysis and emulator training include it when sa_options / emulator_settings include_prediction_items is true

protocol_info.description: pre_times, sim_times, params_to_change, and the optional experiment_*, offline_pre_time, comment, protocol_traces and protocol_shapes keys; unknown keys are rejected by the parser

oneOf.description: legacy: a bare list of data items

item.description: one data or prediction item; see the obs_data documentation
